label: Total Revenue
description: Gross recognised revenue in the accounting period from sales and services.
owner: Finance Subject-Matter Reviewer (to be named, D-04)

label: Total Expenses
description: Operating and administrative expenses incurred during the accounting period.
owner: Finance Subject-Matter Reviewer (to be named, D-04)

label: Net Profit
description: Profit derived deterministically as total revenue minus total expenses.
owner: Finance Subject-Matter Reviewer (to be named, D-04)

label: Profit Margin (%)
description: Net profit as a percentage of total revenue. Zero revenue gives 0.00 with a zero-denominator flag.
owner: Finance Subject-Matter Reviewer (to be named, D-04)
